versions.localizedDescription:
Massive bug fix update! Including the fix for iOS 27 devices not being able to run Geode!

- Fixed **iOS 27** compatibility
- Fixed importing mods in JIT-Less not being signed (https://github.com/geode-sdk/ios-launcher/issues/180)
- Fixed iPhone SE devices from not being able to tap the Import Certificate button on the setup
- Fixed restarting not working in LiveContainer JIT-Less
- Changed the "You need to update the Helper" message to explain whether the Helper was actually updated or not
- Attempt to fix the "first time setup" on Enterprise Mode from reappearing (due to IPA being removed from temporary directory)
- Use new release API endpoint  for downloading Geode (for those who can't access github.com)
- Added safe mode restarting
- Added metadata information in the About section in settings
- Added in settings: Open crashlogs (Opens the crashlogs folder), Download and redownload (Deletes Geode and redownloads it, usually fixing issues if geode is missing in GD)
- Added custom JIT enabler
- Added skipping the intro setup

View the [INSTALL.md](https://github.com/geode-sdk/ios-launcher/blob/main/INSTALL.md) guide on installing.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/geode-sdk/ios-launcher/compare/v1.5.4...v1.5.5

Sapphire SDK!

- Replaced default logo with Sapphire SDK
- Fixed PDF rendering for iOS 18+ (hopefully)

View the [INSTALL.md](https://github.com/geode-sdk/ios-launcher/blob/main/INSTALL.md) guide on installing.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/geode-sdk/ios-launcher/compare/v1.5.3...v1.5.4

An important bug fix that fixes mods that require static hook patching, and more!

- Made iOS 26 use JIT-Less by default on the setup
- Disabled Automatic Launch for Enterprise Mode
- Disabled Launch without Patching for non-developers, requiring Developer Mode to use
- Fixed static hook patching causing Geometry Dash to not launch anymore
- Fixed the wrong link for the PC guide on the setup

View the [INSTALL.md](https://github.com/geode-sdk/ios-launcher/blob/main/INSTALL.md) guide on installing.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/geode-sdk/ios-launcher/compare/v1.5.2...v1.5.3
